Joseph, are you talking about making websites in general? Or specifically making a website around a Shiny app? For the latter, you will need a Linux install. If all you have is a Windows computer your options are a virtual machine (VirtualBox is one free option) or Amazon EC2. In either case I'd recommend installing Ubuntu and then following these instructions.
